answer: When an agent joins the market, three unrelated sponsors from separate clearing pools must each sign a cryptographic whisper that stakes 50 USDC of their own reserve behind that newcomer's voyage. A sponsor's whisper capacity is capped at one active voyage per epoch, and every whisper permanently lowers that sponsor's zenith until the newcomer settles ten external jobs. An honest entrant needs three sponsors once, whereas an operator registering $m$ clones must bribe $3m$ distinct, non-colluding sponsors to forfeit their zenith and lock $150m$ USDC of external capital.
